history.title: Request history
history.description: How long settled requests, quota asks and notifications are kept before the Gateway deletes them.

history.disabledHint: 0 keeps everything: nothing is ever deleted.
history.invalidDays: Use a whole number of days between 0 and 3650.
history.scopeHint: Only settled rows are removed — approved, rejected, succeeded or failed. A pending request is never deleted, however old it is. Deletion is permanent and applies to every user.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: What is allowed, in two halves: the registries an image may come from, and the routes open between registries. A rule names an upstream source — without both, nothing moves.

enterpriseCa.title: Enterprise CA
enterpriseCa.description: The private certificate authority the whole instance trusts, on top of the public roots. Applies to every outgoing connection: Harbor API calls, connection tests, and the skopeo jobs that copy images.
enterpriseCa.disabled: The beta is off on this instance (CUSTOM_CA_BETA_ENABLED=false). A stored bundle is kept but no new transfer or mirror will use it.
enterpriseCa.notConfigured: No CA configured — the instance trusts the public root authorities only.
enterpriseCa.replaceLabel: Replace with a new PEM bundle
enterpriseCa.hint: Public PEM certificates only. TLS stays verified: this adds a trusted authority, it does not disable any check.
enterpriseCa.saveFailed: Could not save the enterprise CA
enterpriseCa.jobDefault: Use it for image copy jobs
enterpriseCa.jobDefaultHint: Default for the skopeo jobs that copy images. The switch in “Transfer an image” starts here, and scheduled mirrors — which have no switch of their own — follow it at every run. The Gateway's own calls to Harbor always use the CA.
enterpriseCa.jobDefaultOn: Copy jobs will use the enterprise CA.
enterpriseCa.jobDefaultOff: Copy jobs will use the public root authorities only.

ldap-config-write.name: LDAP configuration write

catalog-browse.name: Catalogue browsing
catalog-browse.degradation: Repositories and artifacts of this Harbor cannot be listed; its images stay invisible in the Gateway.

artifact-delete.name: Artifact deletion
artifact-delete.degradation: Images cannot be deleted on this Harbor, including as part of a fleet-wide deletion.

vulnerability-scan.name: Vulnerability scanning
vulnerability-scan.degradation: Scans cannot be triggered and reports cannot be read, so severity-based transfer rules cannot be enforced here.

sbom-generation.name: SBOM generation
sbom-generation.degradation: The SBOM switch is left out of the request rather than sent: scan-on-push still applies, SBOM-on-push does not.

cosign-signature.name: Signature detection

system-robot.name: System robot
system-robot.degradation: No system robot can be provisioned, so pushes fall back to credentials that carry more rights than they should.

retention-policy.name: Retention policy
retention-policy.degradation: Retention rules cannot be applied to this Harbor; images accumulate until removed by hand.

project-quota.name: Project quota
project-quota.degradation: Storage quotas cannot be read or set on this Harbor.

replication-endpoint.name: Replication endpoints

replication-policy.name: Replication policies
